findings.title: Findings converge on D2's writer-side last-status map
findings.why_it_matters: Three findings patch the same guessed copy of table state
findings.recommended: B: Keep the D2 map and address Findings 3, 4 and 5 individually.
findings.chosen: B: Keep the D2 map and address Findings 3, 4 and 5 individually.

findings.title: D4's connection-row state machine is unspecified
findings.why_it_matters: Core-wait flag has no close rule and can overlap a gap
findings.recommended: B: Drop the flag; the first core wait with no gap open opens the gap
findings.choice_reason: User asked whether peers do this; peer survey (Gatus, Uptime Kuma, HA recorder, Kubernetes) showed one row per state change, added as option C

findings.title: The dedupe map can advance on a dropped write
findings.why_it_matters: A drop can silently suppress the next real row
findings.recommended: A: Advance only on successful enqueue; evict the key on any drop or skip
findings.chosen: A: Advance only on successful enqueue; evict the key on any drop or skip
findings.choice_reason: Asked for peer evidence first; Kubernetes event recorder never lets a failed write suppress a later event

findings.title: from_status has no stated source
findings.why_it_matters: Column meaning unspecified; map and event can disagree
findings.recommended: A: Take from_status from the event's previous_status only
findings.chosen: A: Take from_status from the event's previous_status only

findings.title: Status-only dedupe key collapses differing failures
findings.why_it_matters: Repeat failures with new exception types read as one row
findings.recommended: A: Key the dedupe on to_status, detail and needs_restart
findings.chosen: A: Key the dedupe on to_status, detail and needs_restart

findings.title: D3 writes no closing row for an app removed while blocked
findings.why_it_matters: Block shows open until session end
findings.recommended: A: Write a block row with to_status='removed'
findings.chosen: A: Write a block row with to_status='removed'

findings.title: Two drop paths aren't counted
findings.recommended: A: Count all three drop paths; check the session before building the insert
findings.chosen: A: Count all three drop paths; check the session before building the insert
findings.choice_reason: User chose to walk the rare batch individually

findings.title: The shutdown drain is bounded
findings.why_it_matters: Final STOPPED rows can be abandoned on a slow drain
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation and reword the Assumed bullet
findings.chosen: B: Accept as a known limitation and reword the Assumed bullet

findings.title: Session retention depends on the NOT EXISTS guard line
findings.why_it_matters: A missed guard line fails session cleanup every cycle
findings.recommended: B: Accept; guard line only, with a test_session_retention.py case
findings.chosen: B: Accept; guard line only, with a test_session_retention.py case

findings.title: D1's structural test must exempt the testing harness
findings.chosen: Scope the structural test to src/hassette/core/ and exempt src/hassette/testing/_simulation.py
